newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil sinks with futures in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil sinks with futures in quiet market.

text.p: NWE gas oil sank lower on Monday as benchmark IPE gas oil eased and amid a fairly lacklustre market, traders said.
July IPE gas oil was $1.50 lower at $161.25 a tonne at 1150 GMT as they played catch-up with Brent falls on Friday after the gas oil futures market closed.
The heating oil barge market was fairly quiet with buyers and sellers wide apart.

A refiner sold barges at July flat fob ARA, but other sellers appeared to be holding out for higher premiums with offers in the July IPE +50 cents to +$1.0 heard. Buyers were bidding around July flat to +25 cents.
Low sulphur diesel premiums were quoted around July IPE +$6.0/+$8.0 fob ARA.
The cargo market was in a similarly lacklustre state with 0.2 percent cargoes talked around July IPE flat/+$1.0.
The low sulphur market continued to be well-supplied with Med cargoes although the Med-North arb was closing fast.
Premiums for lower sulphur cargoes were quoted around July IPE +$5.0/+$6.0 cif NWE.
"There's still quite a lot of material slopping around," said one trader. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
